declarations.name: AuiCandlestickChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (session count, date range, first and last close with the change, highest high and lowest low, sessions not plotted).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for prices (tooltips, accessible names, table, summary, ticks).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash?; axisColor?; lineWidth?; markerSize?; cornerRadius?; barRadius?; cellRadius?; sliceRadius?; boxRadius?; swatchRadius?; tooltipRadius?; controlRadius?; lineJoin?; areaOpacity?; gradient?; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair and tooltip at the same column (session index) when one is hovered or focused. Use charts with the same sessions.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Sessions: { date: PlainDate (strictly increasing); open, high, low, close: finite numbers (high >= open, close, low; low <= open, close); volume?: number >= 0 }. At most 20,000.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Candles (hollow when rising, filled when falling) or OHLC bars (falling bars dashed).

inputs.name: volume
inputs.description: Volume pane below the prices when the data has volume.

inputs.name: movingAverages
inputs.description: Up to 4 simple moving averages of the close: { period: 2-250 sessions; id?: string (default "ma<period>"); label?: string; color?: 1-8; style?: ChartSeriesStyle }.

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Business calendar (createBusinessCalendar from @absoluteui/components/business-calendar): the axis counts trading days only, so weekends and holidays take no space; sessions on non-working days are not plotted and are listed in the summary. Without it the axis is a calendar-day axis with gaps.

inputs.name: priceAxis
inputs.description: Price axis: { label?, min?, max?, tickCount? (2-20) }.

inputs.name: volumeFormat
inputs.description: Volume format (tooltips, table, pane label). Default compact notation.

inputs.name: zoom
inputs.description: Zoom and pan over time: toolbar buttons, + / - / 0 keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, drag to pan, Shift + drag to select.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Legend of the moving averages (toggle buttons): auto shows it when there is at least one average, show always, hide never.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (date, open, high, low, close, volume, and every moving average): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Dash patterns on the moving averages (WCAG 1.4.1). Candles are always hollow (rising) or filled (falling). Forced-colors mode always shows them.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: crosshair
inputs.description: Crosshair lines (time and price) on the hovered or focused session.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number, date, and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the time axis and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Ids of hidden moving averages (legend toggles).

models.name: zoomRange
models.description: Visible axis range { from, to } in axis positions (trading-day or day index from the first session); null shows everything.

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A candle was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused candle. label is the date, column the session index, value the formatted close.

outputs.name: seriesToggled
outputs.description: A moving average was shown or hidden from the legend.

outputs.name: zoomed
outputs.description: The visible range changed (also announced politely).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide an item programmatically (no event).

accessibility.pattern: SVG time-series chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "candlestick chart") of role="img" candles with roving focus along the sessions; a legend of toggle buttons for moving averages; zoom toolbar; data table fallback.

limitations: Daily sessions only (PlainDate); no intraday or weekly aggregation.
Simple moving averages of the close only (up to four).
